item.tib: zab don rin chen phreng ba las 'dren chog thar pa'i lam 'dren
item.coloph: zhes kyi 'dren chog 'di ni gsang sngags gling pas gter du drangs shing / phyis su khro bon yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyis phur pa'i gnas 'dren zhig dgos gsungs bzhin du/ 'di sbyar na 'thad pa lhang bas dag par phab pa'o//
